look: Data Metropolis: futuristic architectural visualization meets premium sci-fi cinematic motion graphics. Sophisticated isometric architecture, abstract digital worlds, precision engineering, monumental scale; elegant geometric towers with hundreds of tiny illuminated windows, glowing infrastructure, small flowing data particles, restrained HUD annotations, refined typography; midnight navy #06111E, near-black #03070D, electric cyan #4DE5FF, warm amber #FFB86B, soft ivory #ECF4FA. A bar chart (2019 20, 2020 32, 2021 48, 2022 65, 2023 83, 2024 100) becomes a city and back, one continuous camera, no crossfades.

scenes.name: The first signal
scenes.desc: In darkness one cyan point lights, the axes and grid draw out, and six bars rise to their values.

scenes.name: Architectural awakening
scenes.desc: The camera turns into isometric space as the bars extrude into towers, windows cascade on and rooftops unfold.

scenes.name: The city comes alive
scenes.desc: The grid folds down into streets, a district rises around the towers and the camera glides low through traffic of light.

scenes.name: Inside the data
scenes.desc: The camera races under a skybridge beside the 2024 tower as numbers stream up its facade and a wave of light crosses the city.

scenes.name: The impossible reveal
scenes.desc: The city freezes, the camera pulls back and up, and streets fold back into the axes and grid of the original chart.

scenes.name: Data Metropolis
scenes.desc: Wide isometric chart-city with the title Data Metropolis and the line Every number builds a world.
